headline: Partner with RoboGrinder
intro: Connect your company with Virginia Tech students who turn classroom knowledge into working systems. Together, we build practical experience and the next generation of engineers.

benefits.title: Meet students ready for industry
benefits.description: Our members work through design reviews, manufacturing, software integration, and testing. Get to know students with practical experience for internships and early-career roles.

benefits.title: Build a relationship with the team
benefits.description: Share engineering experience through mentorship, technical conversations, and feedback. Help students understand the challenges your company solves.

benefits.title: Put your contribution in view
benefits.description: Discuss recognition through our website, team media, and competition presence. We can agree on opportunities that fit your contribution and goals.

imageAlt: RoboGrinder students and robots at a robotics competition

supportOptions.title: Fund the build
supportOptions.description: Help cover materials, components, travel, and the other costs of a new season.

supportOptions.title: Share your expertise
supportOptions.description: Connect students with engineers, technical mentors, and real-world feedback.

supportOptions.title: Equip the team
supportOptions.description: Contribute tools, parts, software, or shop resources that support student projects.
